heading: Date of termination
lead: No duty-free treatment provided under this subchapter shall remain in effect after December 31, 2020.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 2465, Pub. L. 93–618, title V, § 505, Jan. 3, 1975, 88 Stat. 2071; Pub. L. 98–573, title V, § 506(a), Oct. 30, 1984, 98 Stat. 3023; Pub. L. 103–66, title XIII, § 13802(b)(1), Aug. 10, 1993, 107 Stat. 667; Pub. L. 103–465, title VI, § 601(a), Dec. 8, 1994, 108 Stat. 4990, related to termination of duty-free treatment and reports, prior to the general amendment of this subchapter by Pub. L. 104–188.
